fact: The Kampala Report states that the Auditor General found critical EMIS administration and configuration functions remain largely under the control of the system vendor, SMSOne, which has run them for four years under an ongoing contract supervised by the ICT ministry and is upgrading the platform from EMIS 1.0 to EMIS 2.0; the system holds data on more than 13 million learners and staff. It names no funder and no plan.
title: Concerns Grow as Private Firm Retains Control of Critical Education Data System
